claim_register.claim: The request guide maps RATAN_TRADE_BLOTTER to Trade Blotter; RATAN_CASHFLOW_BLOTTER to FX and Equity Cashflow Blotter; RATAN_STRATEGIC_CASHFLOW_BLOTTER to strategic Cashflow Blotter; and RATAN_CASHFLOW_GROUP_BLOTTER to Grouping Blotter. RATAN_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION and RATAN_SETTLEMENT_EXCEPTION identify their exception tiles. RATAN_PROFILE_LIMITS identifies Authorization Limits. RATAN_SETTLEMENT_STP_RULE, RATAN_SUPPRESSION_RULE, and RATAN_AUTO_NETTING_RULE identify business-rule tiles, including the listed FX/Equity or Swift/Cashflow variants. RATAN_ENTITLEMENT_RULE labels Data Entitlement Rules in this request table. RATAN_NOSTRO_BLOTTER labels both Nostro Static and BIC Netting Static; RATAN_NETTING_RULE labels Netting Static. RATAN_MO_EXCEPTION is struck through as unused. These request labels do not establish runtime permission grants or resolve the duplicate static subject.

CES onboarding or entitlement errors appear in UI and require CES onboarding. For network issues, Auth service retries three times. Auto-recovery and Ops alerts are recorded checklist intentions, without execution results.
